decisionQuote: 放弃我们的风格，保留偏心，取中国文化意象，敦煌风格画一个古人意象里的变色龙
findings: Owner withdrew the faceted animal-family drawing language for this project. Mineral palette was accepted in principle; the drawing system and expression changed instead. Kept as history; replacement study 2026-10-24-03 paints an ancient-imagined chameleon beast in Dunhuang mural language.
